title: 636017 Move report action tooltips to report objects (small areas)
summary: Report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, with duplicate tooltips removed from pages. This uses the new 2025 wave 1 feature where actions inherit UI descriptors from target objects.
key_points: Tooltips for 5 reports (Employee Absences, Create Fiscal Year, Assemble to Order, User Task Utility) moved to report object level
Duplicate tooltip properties removed from 4 page actions
Leverages new feature where running objects in actions defaults to UI descriptors on target objects
Changes affect small areas: HumanResources, Foundation, Assembly, and Modules
Metadata-only change with no functional behavior impact
quote: The tooltip is now defined once on the report and applies wherever the report is invoked
